method: v1.5.0 source-contract review by the current execution agent of 67 forward and 73 adversarial prompts. All prior 55/63 prompts were checked for compatibility with the shared communication and guidance rules and changed owning routes; prior v1.4.0 evidence is retained for unchanged implementation behavior, not represented as a new independent model run. Updated the shared question budget in the two affected ensemble cases. Added 12/10 guidance cases with explicit contract evidence, supported where applicable by isolated preference, front-door and installer fixtures. Pass means the reviewed source contract satisfies that case; automatic test execution is reported separately. This is not independent model trials, actual new-task discovery, real Codex/Claude/DSH/ST invocation, driver acceptance, current-client installation or release.

releaseDeltaReviews.method: Bounded source delta review and executed local regression, preserving the original source-contract review and case outcomes. Only the Library CLI serializer and its regression test changed: JSON Unicode escaping is confined to process stdout/stderr. Parsed receipt fields, direct API behavior, persisted bytes, authorization and guidance instructions are unchanged. Original 67/73 case results are retained, not claimed as fresh independent model trials.
